_doc: Committee-ID -> candidate map for the IPG Elections tool. This is the elections analog of ward-map.json: a hand-maintained lookup that grows as you identify each candidate's SBE committee. Add one entry per candidate committee. Keys are SBE committee_id (string). donor_id values are produced downstream by the shared ingest.py, so any classification in the master Sheet flows to BOTH tools automatically -- never re-classify donors here. race_id must match one of the races generated by build_election_seed.py (sb-president, sb-d01..sb-d20, mayor, city-clerk, city-treasurer, ward-01..ward-50).
_status_values: declared | filed | certified | withdrawn | disqualified | incumbent-pending
